parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activity rows with non-null pChEMBL values against the human single-protein target CHEMBL4282 (RAC-alpha serine/threonine-protein kinase). Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, assays on assay_id, and target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL4282, target_type SINGLE PROTEIN, tax_id 9606, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
